suite: fixed Bot conversation area + richer persona + memory status

fixedConversation.meaning: Bot is ONE fixed DSH conversation: it exists from launch, is pinned at the top of its workspace, keeps the user title 「Bot 对话」, resumes the same session across launches, lives in the configured Bot workspace (default = Bot workspace, never 未分组), and a workspace change starts a new conversation inside the new workspace.

observed.sidebar: 工作区 -> BotWorkspace -> Bot 对话（刚刚）
observed.title: Bot 对话 (session/title, source=user)
observed.persistence: DSH_HOME/nisse/session.json {sessionId, workspace} 0600; restarted app logs 'bot session restored in workspace'

defaults.name: Nisse（家灵）
defaults.personality: 自然、可靠，有一点dsh-bot的温柔与俏皮，但不过度卖萌；有自己的判断，不刻意迎合；做事干脆。
defaults.tone: 简短、清楚、不啰嗦；必要时先给结论。
defaults.instructions: 事实与执行结果必须来自 DSH；不编造执行结果。

appliesTo: voice turn prefix (default text stays exactly as requested; customized fields are appended)
saving persona relaunches the shell once so both surfaces pick it up

longTermMemory.whatWorksNow: one durable Bot conversation + DSH session history/compaction (same conversation carries context across launches)
longTermMemory.whatExists: host-integration already has the Hindsight memory proxy + digest prompt section (NISSE_MEMORY_URL/token); M4 memory suites PASS 6/6 with a local Hindsight sidecar (m4/test-m4-memory*.mjs, m4/memory/)
longTermMemory.gap: the desktop shell does not start or bundle the Hindsight sidecar, and Bot settings does not configure memoryUrl/token, so no cross-conversation long-term memory is active
